{{Quote|Care to introduce your friend, Jolee?''"<br />"''What, are you deaf? His name's Davin. Old friend from my wanderer days.|[[Revan/Legends|Revan]] and [[Jolee Bindo]]|<ref name="Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Davin Kotras''' was a smuggler and pilot before and during the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]]. He was a good friend of [[Jolee Bindo]], [[Sunry]], and [[Elora]], and had shared many adventures with Bindo during his adventuring days. During the [[Jedi Civil War]], Davin came across Jolee once again and told him of the predicament of another friend of theirs, a war veteran named [[Sunry]], who had been arrested for murder on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]].
